questions.stem: 每年都有大片森林被砍伐來開闢農地，導致生物多樣性（biodiversity）快速流失。
questions.answer: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down to make room for crops, causing a rapid loss of biodiversity.
accepted_answers: Large areas of forest are cleared every year to create space for crops, leading to a rapid loss of biodiversity.
Every year, huge areas of forest are cut down to make way for farms, resulting in a sharp drop in biodiversity.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，導致…）

questions.stem: 幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食的蜜蜂，也已因棲息地消失而受到嚴重傷害。
questions.answer: Bees, which help produce one third of our food, have also been severely harmed by the loss of their habitats.
accepted_answers: Bees, which help to produce a third of our food, have also been badly hurt by the loss of their habitats.
Bees, which help produce one third of the food we eat, have also been seriously harmed because their habitats are disappearing.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（補充說明泛指的蜜蜂：Bees, which …,）
完成式被動（已經受到傷害）

1.explanation_zh: 「森林被砍伐」用被動 are cut down（森林是被砍的對象），「每年」是一再發生的事實，用現在簡單式。「來開闢農地」是目的，用不定詞 to make room for crops。「，導致…」用句尾分詞 causing／leading to／resulting in，它的邏輯主詞是前面「森林被砍伐」這整件事，所以不用再加 and 或 which。「快速流失」寫成名詞片語 a rapid loss of biodiversity。
evidence: 導致生物多樣性（biodiversity）快速流失
1.strategy_zh: 先找出句子的骨幹「森林被砍伐」（被動），再把「來…」當目的、「導致…」當結果，分別用不定詞與句尾分詞接在主要子句後面。
hints: 切成四段：每年都有大片森林被砍伐／來開闢農地／導致／生物多樣性快速流失
標的詞彙：forest（森林）、cut down（砍伐）、crop（農作物）、loss（流失）、rapid（快速的）
句型框架：S + be + p.p. + to VR …, causing / leading to + N

2.explanation_zh: 「蜜蜂」在這裡是泛指，修飾語只是補充說明牠們的功能，所以用逗號加 which 的非限定關係子句；限定用法 that 會變成「只有某些蜜蜂」。「已…受到傷害」是到現在為止的結果，用現在完成式被動 have been harmed，主詞 Bees 是複數用 have。「三分之一」是 one third 或 a third；「也」放在 have 和 been 之間：have also been。
evidence: 幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食的蜜蜂
也已因棲息地消失而受到嚴重傷害
2.strategy_zh: 先抓主幹「蜜蜂也已受到嚴重傷害」，再把前面的長修飾語改成 which 子句插在主詞後面，最後用 by＋名詞片語交代原因。
hints: 切成四段：幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食／的蜜蜂／因棲息地消失／而受到嚴重傷害
標的詞彙：bee（蜜蜂）、produce（生產）、harm（傷害）、habitat（棲息地）
句型框架：N, which + V …, + have also been + p.p. + by …

references: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down to make room for crops, causing a rapid loss of biodiversity.
Large areas of forest are cleared every year to create space for crops, leading to a rapid loss of biodiversity.
Every year, huge areas of forest are cut down to make way for farms, resulting in a sharp drop in biodiversity.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，導致…）
patterns.frame: S + be + p.p. …, causing / leading to / resulting in + N

parts.zh: 每年都有大片森林被砍伐
accepted: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down
Large areas of forest are cleared every year
Every year, huge areas of forest are cut down
Every year, large areas of forest are cut down
Every year, vast areas of forest are cleared
Every year, large forests are cut down

common_errors.wrong: Every year has large forests cut down
common_errors.right: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「每年都有…」的「有」不是 has；英文以森林當主詞，寫成被動句。

common_errors.wrong: Every year, vast areas of forest cut down
common_errors.right: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down
common_errors.explanation_zh: 森林是「被」砍伐，要用 be＋p.p.；少了 are 就變成森林去砍東西。
「開闢」不是 open；意思是騰出土地來種作物，寫 make room for crops／farms。
表目的用不定詞 to＋原形動詞。

common_errors.wrong: , cause a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.right: , causing a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後直接接原形動詞 cause，句子就有兩個動詞；表結果要用分詞 causing。

common_errors.wrong: , leading a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.right: , leading to a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.explanation_zh: lead 表「導致」要接 to：lead to＋名詞。

common_errors.right: causing a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.explanation_zh: lose 是及物動詞，不能這樣用；「流失」改成名詞 loss，前面用形容詞 rapid 修飾。

common_errors.wrong: causing a rapid lost of biodiversity
common_errors.right: causing a rapid loss of biodiversity
common_errors.explanation_zh: 名詞是 loss，lost 是過去式、過去分詞。

traps.explanation_zh: 「流失」在這裡是抽象名詞概念，接在 causing／leading to 後面最自然的是名詞片語 a rapid loss of biodiversity；照中文詞序把「快速」寫成副詞、「流失」寫成動詞，就會出現 lose 沒有受詞的錯誤。

traps.literal_error: Every year, vast areas of forest are cut down to make room for crops, cause a rapid loss of biodiversity.
traps.explanation_zh: 「，導致…」要用句尾分詞 causing／leading to／resulting in；直接寫原形 cause 會讓一個句子出現兩個主要動詞。

bonus.text: With vast areas of forest cleared for farming every year, biodiversity is being lost at an alarming rate.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 with＋受詞＋p.p. 的獨立結構交代背景，主要子句改用進行式被動 is being lost，強調流失「正在發生」。

1.restructuring_zh: 「每年都有大片森林被砍伐」中文用「有」帶出事件，英文不要寫 Every year has…，改成以「森林」當主詞的被動句 vast areas of forest are cut down；「導致生物多樣性快速流失」把「流失」名詞化，寫成 causing a rapid loss of biodiversity。

references: Bees, which help produce one third of our food, have also been severely harmed by the loss of their habitats.
Bees, which help to produce a third of our food, have also been badly hurt by the loss of their habitats.
Bees, which help produce one third of the food we eat, have also been seriously harmed because their habitats are disappearing.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（補充說明泛指的蜜蜂：Bees, which …,）
patterns.zh_trigger: 幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食的蜜蜂

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（已經受到傷害）
patterns.zh_trigger: 已因棲息地消失而受到嚴重傷害

parts.zh: 幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食
accepted: help produce one third of our food
help to produce a third of our food
help produce one third of the food we eat
help produce a third of our food
help to produce one third of our food

common_errors.wrong: help producing one third of our food
common_errors.right: help produce one third of our food
common_errors.explanation_zh: help 後面接原形動詞（或 to＋原形），不接 V-ing。

common_errors.wrong: help produce one three of our food
common_errors.right: help produce one third of our food
common_errors.explanation_zh: 分數的分母用序數：三分之一是 one third／a third。

common_errors.wrong: The bees that help produce one third of our food
common_errors.right: Bees, which help produce one third of our food,
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡說的是所有蜜蜂（泛指），只是補充說明牠們的功能，要用逗號加 which；用 that 會變成「只有某些蜜蜂」。

common_errors.wrong: Bees, they help produce one third of our food,
common_errors.right: Bees, which help produce one third of our food,
common_errors.explanation_zh: 補充說明用關係代名詞 which，不能再放一個主詞 they。

accepted: by the loss of their habitats
by the loss of their homes
because they are losing their habitats

common_errors.right: by the loss of their habitats
common_errors.explanation_zh: by 是介系詞，後面要接名詞片語；「棲息地消失」寫成 the loss of their habitats。

common_errors.wrong: because of their habitats are disappearing
common_errors.explanation_zh: because of 後面接名詞；接子句要用 because。
蜜蜂是受害的一方，要用完成式被動 have been＋p.p.；少了 been 就變成蜜蜂去傷害別人。
主詞 Bees 是複數，用 have。

traps.zh: 幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食的蜜蜂
traps.literal_error: Bees help produce one third of our food have also been severely harmed.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把很長的修飾語放在名詞前面；英文要把它搬到名詞後面，寫成關係子句，否則句子會出現兩個動詞（help、have been）。
「棲息地消失」放在「因…而」裡，英文用 by 時要寫成名詞片語 the loss of their habitats；也可以改寫成子句 because their habitats are disappearing。

bonus.text: Bees, on which one third of our food depends, have also been severely harmed by the loss of their habitats.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用「介系詞＋關係代名詞」on which，把「我們三分之一的糧食仰賴蜜蜂」寫進非限定子句，句構更緊湊。

2.restructuring_zh: 「幫忙生產我們三分之一糧食的蜜蜂」是很長的前置修飾，英文要把修飾語搬到名詞後面，寫成非限定關係子句 Bees, which …,；「因棲息地消失而受到嚴重傷害」中文先因後果，英文先寫結果 have been severely harmed，再用 by the loss of their habitats 交代原因。

1.translation: Every year, large areas of forest are cut down to make room for farmland, leading to a rapid loss of biodiversity.
1.explanation_zh: 「每年都有…被砍伐」是一般事實，用現在簡單式被動 are cut down；「來開闢農地」用不定詞片語 to make room for farmland 表目的；「導致」接在整個子句後，用分詞構句 leading to 表結果。

2.translation: Bees, which help produce one third of our food, have also been seriously harmed by the loss of their habitats.
2.explanation_zh: 蜜蜂是泛指，修飾語是補充說明，用非限定關係子句 which help produce…；「已…受到嚴重傷害」用現在完成式被動 have been seriously harmed；「因棲息地消失」譯成 by the loss of their habitats。

issues_zh: 我把「農地」譯成 farmland（to make room for farmland），這是「農地」最直接的英譯，但第 2 部分 accepted 只有 crops／farms／farming／clear land for crops，標的詞 crop 的 alternatives（farm／farming／agriculture）也沒有 farmland，所以照規準算不在可接受寫法內。
建議第 2 部分 accepted 補 to make room for farmland、to clear land for farming、to make room for agricultural land；標的詞改以 farm 或 farmland 為主，alternatives 補 farmland／agricultural／crop。crop 本身其實是「作物」，不是「農地」的對譯。
標的詞彙我用到 4/5（80%），剛好在門檻上；程式若不把 farmland 算成 farm，這句就是踩線通過。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: Every year, large areas of forest are cut down to make room for farmland, which leads to a rapid loss of biodiversity.
1.explanation_zh: 「被砍伐」用被動式 are cut down；「開闢農地」譯成 to make room for farmland（不定詞表目的）；「導致……」用 which leads to 接續整個前面的情況。

2.translation: Bees, which help produce one third of our food, have also been seriously harmed by the loss of their habitats.
2.explanation_zh: 「幫忙生產……的蜜蜂」用非限定關係子句補充說明；「已受到傷害」用現在完成式被動 have been harmed，因為影響延續到現在；「因棲息地消失」譯成 by the loss of their habitats。

issues_zh: 我的譯文 to make room for farmland 不在第 2 部分 accepted 內：「農地」最直接的對應詞 farmland 沒有收，target_words 的 crop 的 alternatives 也只有 farm／farming／agriculture，建議補 farmland、farms、farm land。

「導致」這一部分的 accepted 只收分詞片語（causing／leading to／resulting in）；寫成非限定關係子句 , which leads to a rapid loss of biodiversity 一樣自然、正確，卻落在 accepted 之外，也代表中文「導致」並沒有強制引出 PART（我自然用了 which 子句而非分詞）。建議把 which leads to／which results in 納入 accepted，或在評分規準註明 PART 只是其中一種可接受寫法。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）
